project.name: Ledgerly
project.descriptor: Intelligent Accounting and Business Management System — a modular ERP and financial management platform for businesses of all sizes.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to create and configure a company profile.
The system must support the creation and maintenance of a chart of accounts.
The system must allow users to create manual journal entries following debit and credit rules.
The system must post transactions to the general ledger and maintain accounting integrity.
The system must generate a trial balance from posted transactions.
The system must produce basic financial statements such as an income statement and balance sheet.
The system must provide audit trails for all financial transactions and changes.
The system must validate transactions to ensure balanced debit and credit entries.
The system must handle invalid accounting data and provide understandable error messages.
The system must support user roles and permissions for access control.
The system must allow for the import and export of data via Excel/CSV.
The system must support customer and vendor management.
The system must manage accounts receivable and payable.
The system must handle sales, purchasing, and expenses.
The system must manage cash and bank transactions.
The system must support inventory management.
The system must support budgeting and cost centers.
The system must support multi-company and multi-branch operations.
The system must provide dashboards and operational and financial reporting.
The system must integrate AI capabilities for financial analysis and insights.
The system must ensure AI-generated analysis is advisory and does not alter authoritative records.
The system must be modular to support future integrations and expansions.

stories.title: Set up a new company profile
stories.narrative: As a business manager, I want to set up a new company profile so that the system knows the entity I am accounting for.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new business, when the profile is created, then legal name, fiscal year and base currency are stored.
Given an incomplete profile, when saved, then required-field errors are shown.

stories.title: Create and maintain chart of accounts
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to create and maintain a chart of accounts so that transactions can be classified correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a company profile, when an account is added, then it is assigned a type and code.
Given a duplicate account code, when saved, then it is rejected with a clear message.

stories.title: Create manual journal entries
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to create manual journal entries so that non-automated transactions are recorded correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journal entry, when debits and credits are entered, then the entry cannot be saved unless they balance.
Given a saved entry, when viewed, then it shows date, accounts, amounts and memo.

stories.title: Post transactions to the general ledger
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want journal entries posted to the general ledger so that account balances stay accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Given an approved journal entry, when posted, then each affected account balance updates atomically.
Given a posting failure, when it occurs, then no partial update is left in the ledger.

stories.title: Produce basic financial statements
stories.narrative: As a financial manager, I want basic financial statements so that I can see the company's financial position.
acceptance_criteria: Given posted transactions, when the income statement is generated, then it reflects the selected period.
Given posted transactions, when the balance sheet is generated, then assets equal liabilities plus equity.

stories.title: Implement audit trails for financial transactions
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want every financial change logged so that transactions can be traced for audit purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given any create, edit or delete on a transaction, when it happens, then an audit record captures who, what and when.
Given an audit record, when viewed, then the prior and new values are both visible.

stories.title: Validate transactions for balanced entries
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want the system to reject unbalanced entries so that the ledger always stays in balance.
acceptance_criteria: Given total debits and total credits, when they are unequal, then the entry is blocked before it can post.
Given a balanced entry, when submitted, then it is accepted without warning.

stories.title: Handle invalid accounting data with error messages
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want clear error messages on invalid data so that I can fix mistakes without guessing.
acceptance_criteria: Given malformed or missing required data, when submitted, then a specific, human-readable error is shown.
Given a validation error, when displayed, then it identifies the exact field at fault.

stories.title: Generate a trial balance
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to generate a trial balance so that I can confirm the ledger is in balance before closing.
acceptance_criteria: Given posted transactions, when the trial balance is run, then total debits equal total credits.
Given a selected period, when the trial balance is run, then only postings within that period are included.

stories.title: Manage customer and vendor profiles
stories.narrative: As a business manager, I want to manage customer and vendor profiles so that I can track who I do business with.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new customer or vendor, when created, then contact and payment terms are stored.
Given an existing profile, when edited, then history of prior transactions is preserved.

stories.title: Manage accounts receivable and payable
stories.narrative: As a financial manager, I want to manage receivables and payables so that I know what is owed and what is due.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice or bill, when recorded, then it appears on the corresponding aging report.
Given a payment applied to an invoice, when saved, then the outstanding balance updates correctly.

stories.title: Handle sales, purchasing, and expenses
stories.narrative: As a business manager, I want to record sales, purchases and expenses so that day-to-day operations are captured in the books.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sale or purchase, when recorded, then the correct revenue/expense and tax accounts are affected.
Given an expense with no receipt, when submitted, then it is flagged for review rather than silently accepted.

stories.title: Manage cash and bank transactions
stories.narrative: As a financial manager, I want to manage cash and bank transactions so that cash position stays reconciled.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank statement line, when matched to a ledger entry, then it is marked reconciled.
Given an unmatched transaction, when reconciliation runs, then it is listed as an exception.

stories.title: Import and export data via Excel/CSV
stories.narrative: As a business manager, I want to import and export data via Excel/CSV so that I can move data in and out of the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid CSV, when imported, then rows are validated before any are committed.
Given a report, when exported, then the file matches the on-screen data exactly.

stories.title: Implement budgeting and cost centers
stories.narrative: As a financial manager, I want budgeting and cost centers so that I can track spend against plan by department.
acceptance_criteria: Given a budget by cost center, when actuals post, then variance is calculated automatically.
Given a cost center with no budget set, when viewed, then it is shown as unbudgeted, not zero variance.

stories.title: Enhance financial reporting capabilities
stories.narrative: As a financial analyst, I want enhanced financial reporting so that I can analyze performance across periods and segments.
acceptance_criteria: Given multiple periods, when compared, then the report shows period-over-period variance.
Given a report filter, when applied, then totals recompute consistently with the filter.

stories.title: Support multi-company operations
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to support multiple companies so that one instance can serve a group of entities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with access to two companies, when switching, then data for the other company is never visible.
Given a new company, when added, then it starts with an isolated chart of accounts.

stories.title: Implement advanced user roles and permissions
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want advanced roles and permissions so that access matches each user's responsibilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a role with limited permissions, when a restricted action is attempted, then it is denied.
Given a permission change, when saved, then it takes effect without requiring re-login.

stories.title: Integrate AI for financial insights
stories.narrative: As a financial analyst, I want AI-generated financial insights so that I can spot trends and anomalies faster.
acceptance_criteria: Given ledger data, when AI analysis runs, then results are labeled advisory and cannot modify records.
Given an AI insight, when displayed, then the underlying data it was derived from is shown alongside it.

stories.title: Prepare system for future integrations
stories.narrative: As a system architect, I want the system built modularly so that future integrations can be added without a rewrite.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new module, when added, then it does not require changes to unrelated modules.
Given the core ledger module, when tested in isolation, then it has no hard dependency on optional modules.

guardrails.statement: The system must provide audit trails for all financial transactions and changes.
The system must validate transactions to ensure balanced debit and credit entries.
The system must handle invalid accounting data and provide understandable error messages.
The system must ensure AI-generated analysis is advisory and does not alter authoritative records.
